title: Bounded TABLECONTENT CONTENTFORMAT across four style scopes

scope.operation: Write the selected CONTENTFORMAT profile at cell, row, column and table style scopes.
scope.profile: Generated AC1027 2x2 scalar grid, one selected type-1, type-2, type-3 or type-4 style at a time, in ASCII and binary DXF.
scope.source_basis: The TABLECONTENT writer already emitted CONTENTFORMAT fields for all style scopes, but its admission path required default content formats for cell, row and column styles. The preceding RPP-5z4 corrected the distinct table-scope gate. This slice extends only the same bounded format profile across the three remaining scopes and rechecks all four.
limits: One selected style per generated table at a time, for each scope type 1 through 4
No margins, borders or TABLESTYLE/CELLSTYLEMAP dependency
scope.claim_boundary: Selected DXF serializer and typed readback evidence only; no native rendering, DWG serialization, dependency graph or general table formatting claim.

implementation: Allow the selected nonempty-string CONTENTFORMAT profile at each of the four TABLEFORMAT style scopes while preserving all other style restrictions.
Revalidate style format strings after plain cell values are counted so the existing aggregate text budget covers cell values, style formats and per-content formats together.
Keep field-domain validation active and refuse unsupported unit values before destination mutation.

evidence.physical_wire: For each scope type 1, 2, 3 and 4, an independent scalar walker finds exactly one CONTENTFORMAT span with exact field order, group-code value types and expected values, including the 0.000 format string. It also confirms the selected style's margin override is zero.
evidence.typed_readback: Fresh imports locate the selected cell, row, column or table style and preserve hasData, scope type, all selected format values, the 0.000 value-format string and absent margins.
evidence.failure_control: Unit type 3 is refused for every scope and encoding; destination sentinels, table collection and explicit caller values remain unchanged.
evidence.retry_control: Restoring unit type 1 permits same-adapter retry for every scope and encoding; fresh typed readback confirms the corrected value.

validation.focused_ctest_result: 6/6 passed; the style-format selector covers four scopes x ASCII/binary and refusal/retry controls, with adjacent grid, linked-data, margin and border regressions

remaining: The parent P5 rendering/TABLE phase remains open.
Other format strings, remaining format-domain combinations, native rendering and DWG output are not claimed.
